subject: Handoff: Elara Health - onboarding & acceptance plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Alice Nguyen <alice@elarahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@elarahealth.com
Date: 2025-06-18 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Elara Health - onboarding & acceptance plan

Hi team — looping CS and delivery in to kick off the formal transition for Elara Health (deal ELR-2025-0921). Quick context: Sales closed last week. Primary objectives for first 60 days are ingesting clinical notes for QA, validating inference latency under production load, and agreeing acceptance criteria for the pilot (see MAP attached).

Essentials:
- Contract: SOW signed (attached: Elara_SOW_v1.2.pdf). Start date target: 2025-07-07.
- Initial scope: 3 pilot workflows (note-extraction, entity linking, reranking), up to 100k tokens/day.
- Success metrics: 95th percentile latency < 350ms at pilot throughput, precision target > 0.88 on annotated set.
- Data residency: US-only (customer VPC not required for pilot).

Requests for CS/delivery:
1) Owner assignment for day-to-day delivery and escalation path.
2) Confirmation of preferred kickoff window (we recommended w/c July 7).
3) Technical intake questions: onboarding SSH keys for SFTP drop, schema for notes (see second tab of MAP).

Internal notes: Customer will provide a small labeled set for initial quality regression tests and will expect a weekly cadence during pilot. Procurement will route invoices net-30; finance contact is cc'd.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, Elara_SOW_v1.2.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on short sync if helpful.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Alice Nguyen <alice@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2025-06-18 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Elara Health - onboarding & acceptance plan

Thanks Karthik — welcome aboard, Alice. I'll pick up as primary CS lead and Jonas will be the technical delivery owner. Monica, can you be our escalation/implementation manager for the pilot?

Proposed assignments:
- CS Lead: Tessa Morgan (primary customer contact for timelines, success metrics, weekly reviews)
- Tech Delivery Lead: Jonas Weber (infrastructure, staging, performance validation)
- Implementation Escalation: Monica Patel (security/compliance, contract edge cases)

Next steps from CS/delivery:
- I'll schedule a 45-min kickoff with Alice & procurement for Tue, 2025-07-08 10:00AM PT. Alice — does that work? If not, propose alternate windows next week.
- Jonas: can you confirm we have a staging pool with a similar GPU profile available 7/7–7/21 for performance testing? If not, list constraints.
- Monica: please review the SOW and flag any operational dependencies (e.g., audit logging, retention settings) by EOD Friday 6/20 so we can align procurement expectations.

I put the MAP in the Drive link; I'll attach a kickoff agenda once the time is locked.

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
tessa@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Alice Nguyen <alice@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2025-06-18 12:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Elara Health - onboarding & acceptance plan

Tessa — I can take the delivery lead. Quick tech notes:
- Staging: I have a 2-GPU A100 staging pool reserved for 7/7–7/14; we can extend if pilot needs longer. Performance baseline collection will take ~2 full-load runs (~3 hours each) plus a run for KV cache priming.
- Data ingress: prefer SFTP drop for initial labeled set; if Elara wants API upload we need their client certs.
- Secrets/keys: We'll use a temporary API key for pilot; for production they want KMS-based keying (Monica, we should confirm KMS provider).

Blocked items I need from Elara before kickoff:
1) sample notes schema (CSV / JSON schema) — Alice, can you drop the example in the Drive folder?
2) confirmation of expected token mix (avg tokens per document).

I'll prepare a short config checklist for the kickoff (staging endpoints, key rotation window, tracing hooks).

—Jonas Weber
Jonas Weber | Delivery Lead, Onboarding | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@elarahealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@elarahealth.com
Date: 2025-06-19 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Handoff: Elara Health - onboarding & acceptance plan

Thanks all — this looks good. Confirming: Tue 7/8 10:00AM PT works for our team (Alice, Priya from data ops, and Raj from infra will join). I've uploaded a sample notes export to the Drive folder and added a short README describing the schema.

Action items on our side:
- We will send SFTP credentials to Jonas by 6/25.
- Procurement will return signed payables notice by 6/24 (cc'd).
- We expect to run two acceptance checkpoints at day 14 and day 30 of pilot.

See you on 7/8. Let us know if you want a separate pre-kickoff 15-min call — otherwise we can cover config in the kickoff.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Head of Data Products | Elara Health
alice@elarahealth.com
